crossRefs.note: For they are my servants, whom I brought out of the land of Egypt. They shall not be sold as slaves.

“I am Yahweh your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.
Yahweh, truly I am your servant. I am your servant, the son of your servant girl. You have freed me from my chains.
For I am Yahweh your God, the Holy One of Israel, your Savior. I have given Egypt as your ransom, Ethiopia and Seba in…

in holiness and righteousness before him all the days of our life.

people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: For to me the children of Israel are servants; they are my servants whom I brought out of the land of Egypt. I am Yahweh your God.
translations.bsb: For the Israelites are My servants. They are My servants, whom I brought out of the land of Egypt. I am the LORD your God.
translations.kjv: For unto me the children of Israel are servants; they are my servants whom I brought forth out of the land of Egypt: I am the LORD your God.
translations.asv: For unto me the children of Israel are servants; they are my servants whom I brought forth out of the land of Egypt: I am Jehovah your God.
